name: electron v45.3.1
body:
# Release Notes for v45.3.1

## Fixes

* Fixed a macOS notification observer leak when unsubscribing via another method. [#55732](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55732) <sup>(Also in [44](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55733), [46](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55731))</sup>
* Stopped trusting certificates issued by `eMudhra`'s revoked RSA intermediates. [#55742](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55742) <sup>(Also in [43](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55744), [44](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55743), [46](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55741))</sup>
